newsitem.title: USA: Laserscope in pact with Medical Alliance.
newsitem.headline: Laserscope in pact with Medical Alliance.

text.p: Laserscope and Medical Alliance Inc Tuesday said they entered into a strategic alliance for the further development of the office-based vascular lesion market using Laserscope's Aura Laser System as the centerpiece product.

Under the agreement, Medical Alliance will become the exclusive fee-for-service provider of Aura Laser Systems in the U.S. and over the next several months will purchase more than $1 million worth of Aura Systems for markets which Medical Alliance currently serves. In addition, Laserscope will receive a portion of the per use equipment fees, which Medical Alliance charges its physicians and/or patients.
